## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 6-fascicle composite text combines [聖德太子](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%81%96%E5%BE%B7%E5%A4%AA%E5%AD%90) Prince Shōtoku's traditional *Shōman gisho* (the Japanese imperial commentary on the *[Śrīmālā-siṃha-nāda-sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0045)*) with the Tang Chinese sub-commentary by [明空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E7%A9%BA) Míngkōng. The work documents the early Sino-Japanese intellectual exchange around the *Śrīmālā*-tradition.

**Abstract**

The composite work spans Shōtoku's death (622, the *terminus post quem* for the parent commentary) to the late Tang (the bracket adopted here, 622 – 850). The Tang sub-commentary by Míngkōng provides important comparative material for Sino-Japanese Buddhist commentarial tradition.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X353) collection.
